% A list of tocloft's \newlistof. run.mjs also builds in draft mode the
% documents of test-staletoc-draft/, each beside the list that pdflatex
% wrote for it, and the test-staleaux-toc fixtures, each beside its stale
% lists, then each document again with no list beside it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
